subject: Vendr onboarding: SSO proxy test window and CAIQ field mapping
messages:
From: Oliver Park <oliver.park@clearspring.io>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: security@clearspring.io
Date: Mon, 5 Dec 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Vendr onboarding - SSO proxy / shard for Redwood

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this. We're ready to kick off Vendr onboarding for ClearSpring. A couple of notes up front:

- We can provide SAML metadata (attached) for our SSO proxy. We probably need a short testing window with Redwood to validate SP-initiated login flows.
- Security asked that CAIQ field-level mapping be documented so they can reconcile controls against your portal. I attached a short export of the vendor questionnaire we received.
- Our security team is ok with a short-lived S3 staging location for sensitive proof-of-possession docs (if your process supports presigned uploads), otherwise we'll upload directly into Vendr.

Can your team confirm: 1) an SSO testing window (2-4 hours) next week, 2) whether you prefer S3 presigned upload or direct Vendr upload for SOC 2 artifacts, and 3) a point of contact for CAIQ mapping?

Attachments: saml-metadata-clearspring.xml (SAML 2.0 metadata), vendor-questions.xlsx

Best,
Oliver
Oliver Park
Head of Partnerships, ClearSpring Health
security@clearspring.io

From: sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
To: Oliver Park <oliver.park@clearspring.io>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 5 Dec 2027 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding - SSO proxy / shard for Redwood

Oliver — thanks for the detail and attachments. Looping in Marcus (integrations), Mina (security/evidence), and Priyom (portal onboarding).

Short answers up-front:
1) SSO testing window: we can do a 3-hour window on Tue 2027-12-07 09:00–12:00 PT. During that time we'll validate the SP metadata you sent and exercise both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. Please confirm if that works.
2) Evidence upload: the fastest and least manual option is presigned S3 uploads into a temporary Redwood bucket with tight ACLs + lifecycle (48h). We'll share presigned URLs for a one-time upload and our security team will then ingest into Vendr.
3) CAIQ mapping POC: Mina will own the mapping and coordinate with your security SME to reconcile field-level expectations.

Operational asks for your team before the test window:
- Confirm SAML entityID and ACS endpoint (your metadata looks good but double-check the AssertionConsumerService URL).
- Provide a short list of 6-8 sample artifacts for the staging S3 (SOC 2 report, encryption architecture diagram, KMS rotation policy, SOC 2 scoping memo, CAIQ evidence files). We will provide presigned URLs for those filenames.
- If you have an IP allowlist for the test, please share; otherwise we'll use temporary allowlist for the window.

I'm attaching a short outline of S3 upload steps we expect (s3-staging-instructions.md) and a proposed CSV that maps CAIQ questions to Vendr fields (cs-caiq-mapping-proposal.csv). Marcus — can your team prepare the Vendr mapping script and a test account?

Thanks,
Sofia
Senior Security Programs Manager | Redwood Inference

From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai, Oliver Park <oliver.park@clearspring.io>
Cc: mina.haddad@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2027 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding - SSO proxy / shard for Redwood

Quick operational notes from the integrations side:

- We'll provision a Vendr test org (redwood-vendr-tests/CS-789) and create two vendor reviewer roles: vendor-upload and vendor-readonly. That will let ClearSpring upload packages while keeping mapping team access separate.
- For CAIQ mapping: the CSV Sofia attached looks like a good start. I'll add Vendr field names in a second column and upload a draft mapping to the Drive link (https://drive.redwood.com/controls/CS-789-CAIQ-Mapping).
- Regarding presigned S3: we'll generate per-file presigned PUT URLs that expire in 48h; our ingestion lambda will validate checksums and move items into a quarantined bucket before pushing to Vendr. Please avoid archive formats with embedded executables — PDFs, PNGs, and signed DOCX are preferred.

Two clarifying Qs for Oliver:
1) Do you have a preferred subject line/metadata pattern for uploads (we'll use it to tag evidence automatically)? e.g. "CS-789_SOC2_<doc_type>_<date>"
2) Who should Mina contact at ClearSpring for attestation questions (name + phone/email)?

I'll be present for the SSO window on Tue.

- Marcus
Director, Integrations | Redwood Inference

From: Oliver Park <oliver.park@clearspring.io>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: mina.haddad@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai, security@clearspring.io
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 14:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding - SSO proxy / shard for Redwood

Thanks all — that timeline works.

Answers: 1) We'll use the suggested naming pattern: CS-789_SOC2_<doc_type>_<YYYYMMDD>. 2) Mina can contact our security SME, Victoria Chen (victoria.chen@clearspring.io, +1-415-555-0198). She's briefed and will join the call during the SSO window.

Planned uploads for staging (we'll push these via presigned links you provide):
- 20271201_CS-789_SOC2_Report.pdf
- 20271201_CS-789_Encryption_Diagram.png
- 20271201_CS-789_KMS-Rotation-Policy.docx
- 20271201_CS-789_Scoping-Memo.pdf
- 20271201_CS-789_CAIG-Evidence.zip (contains per-control artifacts)

We will also test a sample SAML login during the window and provide logs if any assertions fail. Looking forward to the test.

Attachments: vendr-onboarding-checklist.pdf

Best,
Oliver
Head of Partnerships, ClearSpring Health
